required_check: Reject fields or aliases for side, order_side, buy, sell, bid_action, ask_action, long, short, reduce, add, maker_side, or taker_side.
reject_if: Any output column or free-text field defines actual or shadow order side.
notes: Read-only context must not become an action artifact.

required_check: Reject fields or aliases for quote price, bid price, ask price, limit price, target price, fair quote, or executable price.
reject_if: Any output defines quote price or price instruction.
notes: Future mid move labels are research outputs only, not quote prices.

required_check: Reject fields or aliases for quote size, order quantity, notional, size multiplier, inventory target, or exposure target.
reject_if: Any output defines quote size or size instruction.
notes: No position or account state is allowed.

required_check: Reject leverage, margin, stop, stop_loss, take_profit, liquidation, or risk order fields.
reject_if: Any output defines leverage or stop/take-profit behavior.
notes: No executable risk-management output is allowed.

required_check: Reject submit, cancel, fill, replace, amend, ack, order_id, client_order_id, lifecycle, or execution event fields.
reject_if: Any output defines or implies order lifecycle behavior.

required_check: Reject trigger, signal, rule, action, decision, enable, disable, entry, exit, or deploy fields when action-capable.
reject_if: Any output can drive strategy or order behavior.

required_check: Reject shadow side, shadow action, shadow quote, shadow size, shadow order, or shadow PnL fields.
reject_if: Any output generates or stores shadow decisions.

required_check: Reject private endpoint, account endpoint, order endpoint, user stream, position, signing, nonce, live, default-on, tiny-live, or bot behavior fields.
reject_if: Any output references private/order/live behavior as allowed or implemented.

required_check: Reject parameter, sweep, grid, optimization, candidate parameter, or selected parameter outputs.
reject_if: Any output performs or records parameter search as a result.

required_check: Reject deploy, rollout, promotion, production, default, enablement, live readiness, or release recommendation outputs.
reject_if: Any output recommends deployment or promotion.

required_check: Scan free-text metadata for action-capable aliases, instructions, or recommendation language.
reject_if: Text instructs order side, quote price/size, leverage, stop/take-profit, submit/cancel/fill, strategy/live/deployment, or promotion.
notes: Boundary text may mention these terms only as prohibitions.

required_check: Require a future validator output proving no action-capable fields exist.
reject_if: No no-action-field validation trace exists in a future implementation artifact.
notes: T006 defines the requirement only; no validator code is implemented here.
